definitionEn: to move quickly on your feet
example: I run in the park every morning.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chạy bộ trong công viên mỗi sáng.

definitionEn: to take part in a game or sport; to make music with an instrument
example: Do you play badminton?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có chơi cầu lông không?

definitionEn: sounds arranged in a pleasant way, made by voices or instruments
example: I listen to music on the bus.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nghe nhạc trên xe buýt.

definitionEn: a musical instrument with six strings
example: He is learning to play the guitar.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy đang học chơi đàn ghi-ta.

definitionEn: to make music with your voice
example: She sings beautifully.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy hát rất hay.

definitionEn: to move your body to music
example: Let's dance together!
exampleTranslation: Mình cùng nhảy nào!

definitionEn: to make a picture with a pencil or pen
example: My little sister loves to draw cats.
exampleTranslation: Em gái tôi rất thích vẽ mèo.

definitionEn: a story shown as moving pictures in a cinema or on TV
example: Let's watch a movie tonight.
exampleTranslation: Tối nay mình xem phim nhé.

definitionEn: an activity or sport with rules that people play for fun
example: Chess is a game for two players.
exampleTranslation: Cờ vua là trò chơi dành cho hai người.

definitionEn: a group of people who play or work together
example: Which team do you support?
exampleTranslation: Bạn ủng hộ đội nào?

definitionEn: a sports competition between two people or teams
example: We watched the match on TV.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi xem trận đấu trên TV.

definitionEn: to be the best or first in a game or competition
example: Our team won the final.
exampleTranslation: Đội chúng tôi đã thắng trận chung kết.

definitionEn: to not win a game; to be unable to find something
example: They lost 2–1.
exampleTranslation: Họ đã thua 2–1.

definitionEn: a place with equipment for doing exercise
example: I go to the gym three times a week.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đến phòng gym ba lần một tuần.

definitionEn: staying outdoors in a tent for a holiday
example: We went camping by the lake.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đã đi cắm trại bên hồ.

definitionEn: to bring things of the same kind together as a hobby
example: He collects old stamps.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy sưu tầm tem cũ.

definitionEn: the art or hobby of taking photos
example: She is interested in photography.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy quan tâm đến nhiếp ảnh.

definitionEn: a large vehicle that carries many passengers on a fixed route
example: I take the bus to work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đi xe buýt đi làm.

definitionEn: a vehicle that runs on rails and carries people or goods
example: The train to Hue leaves at eight.
exampleTranslation: Chuyến tàu đi Huế khởi hành lúc tám giờ.

definitionEn: a road vehicle with four wheels and an engine
example: My uncle has a new car.
exampleTranslation: Chú tôi có một chiếc ô tô mới.

definitionEn: a vehicle with two wheels and an engine
example: Most people in Vietnam ride a motorbike.
exampleTranslation: Hầu hết người Việt Nam đi xe máy.

definitionEn: a vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing pedals
example: I ride my bicycle to school.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đạp xe đến trường.

definitionEn: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere
example: Let's take a taxi home.
exampleTranslation: Mình bắt taxi về nhà đi.

definitionEn: a public road in a city or town with buildings on each side
example: There are many cafés on this street.
exampleTranslation: Con phố này có nhiều quán cà phê.

definitionEn: the vehicles moving on roads
example: The traffic is heavy in the morning.
exampleTranslation: Giao thông buổi sáng rất đông.

definitionEn: a structure that goes over a river or road
example: We walked across the old bridge.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi bộ qua cây cầu cũ.

definitionEn: a place where trains or buses stop for passengers
example: Meet me at the train station.
exampleTranslation: Gặp tôi ở ga tàu nhé.

definitionEn: a piece of paper or card that shows you have paid to travel or enter
example: How much is a bus ticket?
exampleTranslation: Một vé xe buýt giá bao nhiêu?

definitionEn: a public area with grass and trees
example: Children are playing in the park.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ đang chơi trong công viên.

definitionEn: a place where people buy and sell food and goods
example: I buy vegetables at the local market.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mua rau ở chợ gần nhà.

definitionEn: the place where two streets or walls meet
example: The bank is on the corner.
exampleTranslation: Ngân hàng nằm ở góc phố.

definitionEn: to change direction to the left
example: Turn left at the traffic lights.
exampleTranslation: Rẽ trái ở chỗ đèn giao thông.

definitionEn: in a direct line, without turning
example: Go straight for 200 metres.
exampleTranslation: Đi thẳng 200 mét.

definitionEn: at a great distance
example: Is the museum far from here?
exampleTranslation: Bảo tàng có xa đây không?

definitionEn: not far from
example: I live near the station.
exampleTranslation: Tôi sống gần nhà ga.

definitionEn: to control a car or other vehicle
example: Can your mother drive?
exampleTranslation: Mẹ bạn có biết lái xe không?

definitionEn: a person walking in a street, not travelling in a vehicle
example: This street is only for pedestrians.
exampleTranslation: Con phố này chỉ dành cho người đi bộ.

definitionEn: a tall plant with a wooden trunk and branches
example: There is a big tree in front of my house.
exampleTranslation: Có một cái cây lớn trước nhà tôi.

definitionEn: the coloured part of a plant
example: He gave her some flowers.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy tặng cô ấy vài bông hoa.

definitionEn: a large natural stream of water flowing to the sea
example: The Red River flows through Hanoi.
exampleTranslation: Sông Hồng chảy qua Hà Nội.

definitionEn: a very high hill
example: Fansipan is the highest mountain in Vietnam.
exampleTranslation: Fansipan là ngọn núi cao nhất Việt Nam.

definitionEn: the large area of salt water that covers much of the earth
example: The sea is calm today.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay biển lặng.

definitionEn: a large area covered with trees
example: Many animals live in the forest.
exampleTranslation: Nhiều loài động vật sống trong rừng.

definitionEn: a large area of water with land all around it
example: We walked around the lake.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi dạo quanh hồ.

definitionEn: the space above the earth where you see clouds and the sun
example: The sky is very blue today.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay bầu trời rất xanh.

definitionEn: an animal often kept as a pet or to guard a house
example: Our dog loves to play in the garden.
exampleTranslation: Con chó nhà tôi rất thích chơi trong vườn.

definitionEn: a small furry animal often kept as a pet
example: The cat is sleeping in the sun.
exampleTranslation: Con mèo đang ngủ dưới nắng.

definitionEn: an animal with feathers and wings that can usually fly
example: I can hear the birds singing.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nghe thấy tiếng chim hót.

definitionEn: an animal that lives and breathes in water
example: There are many fish in this pond.
exampleTranslation: Có nhiều cá trong cái ao này.

definitionEn: a large farm animal kept for milk or meat
example: The cows are eating grass in the field.
exampleTranslation: Những con bò đang ăn cỏ ngoài đồng.

definitionEn: a very large grey animal with a long nose called a trunk
example: Elephants live in Dak Lak.
exampleTranslation: Voi sống ở Đắk Lắk.

definitionEn: an animal with a long tail that climbs trees
example: The monkey took my banana!
exampleTranslation: Con khỉ lấy mất quả chuối của tôi!

definitionEn: an animal kept at home for company
example: Do you have any pets?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có nuôi thú cưng không?

definitionEn: living or growing in nature, not kept by people
example: Tigers are wild animals.
exampleTranslation: Hổ là động vật hoang dã.

definitionEn: to keep someone or something safe from harm
example: We must protect the forests.
exampleTranslation: Chúng ta phải bảo vệ rừng.

definitionEn: the natural world of land, water, air, plants and animals
example: Plastic bags are bad for the environment.
exampleTranslation: Túi ni-lông có hại cho môi trường.

definitionEn: damage to air, water or land by harmful substances
example: Air pollution is a big problem in big cities.
exampleTranslation: Ô nhiễm không khí là vấn đề lớn ở các thành phố lớn.

definitionEn: feeling pleased and cheerful
example: I'm so happy to see you!
exampleTranslation: Mình rất vui được gặp bạn!

definitionEn: unhappy
example: She was sad when her friend moved away.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy buồn khi bạn mình chuyển đi.

definitionEn: having a strong feeling of being annoyed
example: Dad was angry because I came home late.
exampleTranslation: Bố tức giận vì tôi về nhà muộn.

definitionEn: feeling that you need to rest or sleep
example: I'm tired after a long day.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mệt sau một ngày dài.

definitionEn: not interested because nothing exciting is happening
example: The kids were bored at home.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ thấy chán khi ở nhà.

definitionEn: feeling very happy and full of energy about something
example: We are excited about the trip.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi rất háo hức về chuyến đi.

definitionEn: thinking that something bad might happen
example: My mum is worried about my exam.
exampleTranslation: Mẹ tôi lo lắng về kỳ thi của tôi.

definitionEn: afraid
example: My little brother is scared of the dark.
exampleTranslation: Em trai tôi sợ bóng tối.

definitionEn: feeling something unexpected has happened
example: I was surprised to get a gift.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ngạc nhiên khi nhận được quà.

definitionEn: a little afraid or worried before something happens
example: I always feel nervous before a test.
exampleTranslation: Tôi luôn thấy hồi hộp trước bài kiểm tra.

definitionEn: caring about other people and wanting to help them
example: It was kind of you to help me.
exampleTranslation: Bạn thật tốt bụng khi đã giúp tôi.

definitionEn: behaving in a pleasant, welcoming way
example: The people here are very friendly.
exampleTranslation: Người dân ở đây rất thân thiện.

definitionEn: nervous about talking to people you don't know
example: She is too shy to speak in class.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy quá nhút nhát để phát biểu trong lớp.

definitionEn: making you laugh
example: My uncle tells funny stories.
exampleTranslation: Chú tôi kể những câu chuyện hài hước.

definitionEn: not wanting to work or make an effort
example: Don't be lazy. Do your homework!
exampleTranslation: Đừng lười nữa. Làm bài tập đi!

definitionEn: always telling the truth
example: He is an honest man.
exampleTranslation: Ông ấy là một người trung thực.

definitionEn: able to wait calmly without getting annoyed
example: A good teacher is patient with students.
exampleTranslation: Một giáo viên giỏi luôn kiên nhẫn với học sinh.

definitionEn: sad because you are alone or have no friends
example: He felt lonely in the new city.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy cảm thấy cô đơn ở thành phố mới.

definitionEn: sure about your own abilities
example: She is confident when she speaks English.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy tự tin khi nói tiếng Anh.

definitionEn: happy to give money, time or help to others
example: My grandparents are very generous.
exampleTranslation: Ông bà tôi rất hào phóng.
